objective: Increase the probability of positive compounding while keeping stocks primary, options exceptional, crypto active around the clock, and cash acceptable. Prefer elite A stocks, allow a reduced-size B best-acceptable stock when no A survives, and let crypto surface more reasonable 24/7 opportunities without removing hard risk controls. This policy cannot eliminate market loss risk.

bestAcceptable.rule: B is a reduced-size fallback, not a waiver. It must still have bullish direction, positive conservative expectancy, adequate history, acceptable R:R, bounded volatility, and every downstream live account/execution/protection guard.

stocks.instructions: Target2 is the qualification target; target1 is for partial profit/de-risking. Use cost-adjusted conservative expectancy when available so execution friction cannot be ignored. A tier always ranks before B tier.

seedLane.rule: User-authorized stock-only seed lane, added 2026-08-26, expanded 2026-08-26 at the user's explicit request. It may bypass only the forward-shadow/real-fill profitability-admission wait (SHADOW_ONLY) for up to maxConcurrentPositions distinct top-ranked entryTier A/ELITE candidates simultaneously, at a fixed $5 order ceiling each -- five concurrent slots at $5 total the same $25 maximum combined exposure as the original single-slot $25 design, just diversified across candidates instead of concentrated in one. Unlike the crypto seed lane, this one is NEVER auto-submitted -- every position still requires the user's own explicit per-order approval for that exact order, exactly like every other stock buy. Every other gate remains mandatory: freshness, liquidity/spread, no-chase-past-maximum-entry, correlation, market-regime policy, buying-power, and broker-resident-or-policy-compliant-synthetic protection. At the user's explicit request, this no longer pauses after stopped trades -- a ticker that stops out is excluded from re-selection for the rest of that UTC day (so the pipeline offers a different distinct candidate instead of immediately re-buying the same loser), and a fresh slot opens up for the next eligible candidate automatically. LIVE_SUSPENDED-equivalent or any candidate already failing a live safety gate never qualifies. Does not raise, and is entirely separate from, the minimumIndependentShadowSamples thresholds (6/12) or the win-rate/average-R bars that gate MICRO_PROBATION/PROBATION in apply-profitability-admission.mjs -- those are completely unchanged by this addition.

options.instructions: An option may be considered only after the underlying clears these research and cost-adjusted gates AND Claude confirms the live Teststock real-fill evidence gate. One whole contract must still fit the active capital-tier dollar-risk cap.

dayTradeSeedLane.rule: User-authorized crypto-only seed lane. It may bypass only the forward-shadow admission wait at a fixed $5 ceiling; every research, freshness, liquidity, spread, no-chase, Robinhood tradability, buying-power and protection gate still applies. LIVE_SUSPENDED never qualifies.

crypto.instructions: Crypto runs 24/7, so the research gate is intentionally more permissive than before to surface more plausible A/A+ setups. Keep positive historical tendency, 4-hour confirmation, BTC context for altcoins, liquidity, defined stops, no leverage, no averaging down, and one-position-at-a-time controls. Broker execution availability remains a separate hard gate.
